result.reason: The redline adds a mutual greater-of cap with a USD 1,000,000 floor, but uses all amounts rather than fees and measures from the event giving rise to the claim. It contains no indirect or consequential damages exclusion, no payment-obligation clarification, and no supplied operative definition showing that any required carve-out is an Excluded Claim. The non-operative margin comment cannot cure those omissions. Because neither level is complete and the payment base is broader than required, the redline is not minimal, although it does not otherwise appear to disturb unrelated commercial terms or introduce an express contradiction.
